name: Effective Range / Proper Stable Labeled Sample Compression
proof: The active-coordinate retention scheme is proper and consistent. It retains every active example, so removing an unretained (necessarily inactive) example does not change the retained sample or reconstruction; hence it is stable. Its size is at most \(\mathrm E(\mathcal H)\).
witness_verification: For the $n$ singletons together with the empty concept, effective range is $n$ while proper stable labeled sample compression size is 1.
